info.title: LayerX public JSON-RPC
info.description: Public JSON-RPC reads, authenticated activity submission and scoped WebSocket subscriptions. Native DID enumeration, asset listing/detail and canonical fee estimation forward to authenticated core reads; unavailable evidence is returned explicitly and balances, metadata or fees are never fabricated. The same endpoint relays the Paxeer EVM JSON-RPC namespaces eth_, net_ and web3_ to the chain's node byte for byte, including eth_sendRawTransaction and batches that mix EVM and LayerX calls; node-side signing methods (eth_accounts, eth_coinbase, eth_sendTransaction, eth_sign, eth_signTransaction, eth_signTypedData, eth_signTypedData_v4, eth_mining) and eth_subscribe/eth_unsubscribe are refused here rather than at the node. The px_ namespace joins both domains through the native precompiles addr (0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001004), layerxCustody (0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001013) and layerxAnchor (0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001014).

methods.name: lx_register
methods.description: Creates one self-service identity principal in the beta tenant. Both arguments are lowercase hexadecimal: a 32-byte Ed25519 signer public key and its 64-byte signature over SHA-256(len-prefixed "layerx-register-binding-v1", tenant, signer_public_key). The subject is derived as beta.<first 16 bytes of SHA-256(len-prefixed "layerx-register-subject-v1", tenant, signer_public_key)>, so registration is idempotent and cannot name another key holder's principal. The result is the identity principal record: tenant, sub, allowed_signer_public_keys, account and audiences. Malformed arguments are -32602; a signature that does not prove possession of the named key is -32002; the per-minute self-registration budget is -32005; an unconfigured or unavailable identity service is -32001 with a machine-readable data.code.

methods.name: lx_requestFunds
methods.description: Claims one beta faucet grant for the authenticated identity principal and proxies it to the faucet service. Requires the same bearer identity session used to provision gateway keys; the signer public key must be one the session authorises, so a principal cannot fund a key it does not hold. The faucet bounds claims per principal per window, and the gateway derives the faucet idempotency key from SHA-256(len-prefixed "layerx-faucet-claim-v1", principal, did, signer_public_key), so a repeated request returns the same grant instead of a second one. The result is the faucet claim record: funded, funding_id, transaction_id, decimal-string amount and network; a claim whose evidence is incomplete is -32603 and is never reported as funded. Malformed arguments are -32602; a missing session, an unauthorised signer key or a faucet refusal is -32002; the per-minute claim budget and faucet quotas are -32005; a faucet that is unconfigured, unavailable or still settling is -32001 with a machine-readable data.code.

methods.name: lx_getAccount
methods.description: Reads one account by 32-byte hexadecimal account id through the public core account read. Returns name, asset_id, balance, next_sequence, frozen, and authenticated node evidence. Invalid selectors are JSON-RPC -32602. Missing or unverifiable evidence is -32001; the public read rate limit is -32005.

methods.name: lx_getBalance
methods.description: Same core account read as lx_getAccount. Clients that need only the current units use balance and asset_id from that object.

methods.name: lx_getBalances
methods.description: Enumerates the complete bounded DID account list from LNI minor 5 committed account reads requested at state-proven level. Returns did, accounts with canonical values, native proof material, freshness and a per-entry verification label, and a listing verification label naming the weakest level any entry achieved: state_proven, checkpoint_finalised or settlement_anchored. No independently verified completeness claim. An empty listing, unavailable or invalid native evidence returns -32001 with core code did_account_listing_unavailable.

methods.name: lx_getReceipt
methods.description: Reads the verified receipt for a 32-byte hexadecimal activity id. A successful result includes receipt bytes and result_code. Missing evidence is JSON-RPC -32001. An admission acknowledgement is never returned as success.

methods.name: lx_getActivityStatus
methods.description: Same receipt read as lx_getReceipt. Activity status is the receipt result state (completed, refused, or the upstream pending/unavailable refusal), not a separate status document.

methods.name: lx_getBatchHeader
methods.description: Reads a sequencer-signed batch header by nonzero decimal batch number. Leading zeros and the value 0 are invalid parameters.

methods.name: lx_getCheckpoint
methods.description: Reads checkpoint evidence by 32-byte hexadecimal checkpoint id. The all-zero identifier is refused.

methods.name: lx_getNodeInfo
methods.description: Handshake node information: protocol_version, network_id, chain_head_sequence, latest_sealed_batch, latest_finalised_checkpoint, authorised_sequencer_key, and advertised capabilities.

methods.name: lx_getSequence
methods.description: One account_id argument reads account next_sequence. With [did, "identity"], reads identity.next_sequence from the authenticated native preparation snapshot for envelope signing. Account and identity sequences are independent.

methods.name: lx_getProof

params.name: account_id
params.description: Required only when kind is account.

methods.description: Verified proof with canonical value and signed batch header. kind activity or receipt takes the activity id. kind account requires activity_id and account_id. Account proofs export the exact verified native proof bytes without reconstruction.

methods.name: lx_sendActivity

schema.description: At most 1048576 hexadecimal characters encoding 524288 bytes. The full JSON request including envelope, parameters and batch overhead remains subject to the 8388608-byte HTTP request bound; ingress may impose a smaller body bound.

methods.description: Requires an activity:write gateway key and the existing route scope for Programs activities. Admits strictly canonical Asset register (1), account_open (4), send (5), receive (6), grant_issue (7), grant_revoke (8), mint (10) and burn (11), plus Programs deploy (1), upgrade (2), call (3), transfer (5), account registration (6) and wind-down (7). Asset pause/unpause (2/3) are excluded and Asset ordinal 9 is reserved and refused. Uses activity-ID outer deduplication and preserves signed protocol idempotency. Returns a verified receipt for executed, verified inclusion for batched, and an exact matching verified checkpoint header for finalised; returns JSON-RPC -32001 with state=pending and requested_commitment when evidence is absent after the bounded wait; no success result or commitment downgrade is returned. An admission acknowledgement never establishes execution.

methods.name: lx_subscribe

params.name: cursor
params.description: Last delivered receipt-feed position for this topic, taken from params.cursor of the last notification received before the connection was lost. Positional: for account subscriptions it follows account_id.

methods.description: Authenticated GET /rpc/ws upgrade using Authorization: LayerX-Key. receipt:read scope for receipts; state:read for checkpoints and account. Server notifications use lx_subscription with params.subscription, params.result and params.cursor. params.cursor is the receipt-feed position last delivered on that subscription, as a canonical decimal string. At most 32 connections, 8 subscriptions per connection and 16 queued receipt wakes. Slow consumers and feed loss close with 1013; key revocation closes with 1008. Reconnect by subscribing again with the cursor of the last notification: receipt subscriptions replay every event after it, checkpoint and account subscriptions replay the current snapshot once, and events replayed on resume are delivered before any live event. The resume window is 16 positions; a wider gap is refused with -32005 and a cursor ahead of chain_head_sequence with -32602, and the subscription is not created. Reconcile through reads after a refused resume. Ping every 5 seconds, idle deadline 60 seconds, connection lifetime one hour. Browser Origin requests are refused. Core requires LAYERX_CORE_RECEIPT_EVENTS_TOKEN_FILE matching the gateway component token. Receipts originate from authenticated native commit waits; checkpoints and account snapshots refresh on wakes, checkpoints also on bounded wait expiry.

methods.name: lx_unsubscribe

params.name: subscription
params.description: Identifier returned by lx_subscribe on this connection.

methods.description: Cancels one subscription on the WebSocket connection that created it and stops its notifications; other subscriptions keep their identifiers and cursors. WebSocket only: over POST /rpc it returns -32004. An identifier that is not active on this connection returns -32602.

methods.name: lx_listAssets
methods.description: Returns one page of assets ordered by ascending asset_id together with next_cursor, observed_head_sequence, state_root and verification=authenticated_committed_snapshot from typed LNI minor-5 AssetRead. The native registry holds up to 1024 records: cursor is the exclusive asset_id to resume after, limit defaults to 64 and may not exceed 256, and next_cursor is null once the page is the last one. A malformed cursor or limit returns -32602; unsupported or unavailable evidence returns -32001. Snapshot authentication is not an independent Merkle proof.

methods.name: lx_getAsset
methods.description: Returns asset metadata, observed_head_sequence, state_root and verification=authenticated_committed_snapshot from typed LNI minor-5 AssetRead. Unknown assets or unavailable evidence return -32001. Amounts are decimal strings and identifiers and custody_reference are hexadecimal.

methods.name: lx_estimateFee

schema.description: At most 1048576 hexadecimal characters encoding 524288 bytes. The full JSON request including envelope, parameters and batch overhead remains subject to the 8388608-byte HTTP request bound; ingress may impose a smaller body bound.

methods.description: Strictly decodes any activity admitted by lx_sendActivity and returns fee as a decimal string, parameter_version, canonical_schedule as hexadecimal, canonical_bytes, observed_head_sequence, state_root and verification=authenticated_committed_snapshot from native FeeEstimate. The native committed schedule determines the canonical-envelope price for Asset 1/2/3/4/5/6/7/8/10/11 and Programs 1/2/3/5/6/7. A schedule requiring unavailable execution or storage units fails closed with -32001. Asset ordinal 9 is reserved and refused. This estimate does not reserve a fee or prove execution.

methods.name: px_resolveAccount
methods.description: Resolves one account across both domains. The argument is either a 0x-prefixed 20-byte EVM address or a LayerX DID (did:layerx:<64 hex> or the bare 64 hex characters of the DID public key). The result is {evm_address, pax_address, layerx_did, layerx_account, bound}: every field comes from the addr precompile's getUnifiedAccount/getEvmAddrByLayerX, the halves that are not bound are null, and bound is false when the EVM address carries no LayerX DID. A LayerX account identifier has no reverse index on chain, so only the DID public key resolves from the LayerX side. An unconfigured Paxeer endpoint is -32001 with data.code=paxeer_rpc_not_configured.

methods.name: px_getAccount
methods.description: Resolves the account and joins both halves: paxeer is {address, balance, nonce} read with eth_getBalance and eth_getTransactionCount at latest, layerx is the public core account read for the DID's main account. Either half is null when the account is not bound or the domain has no record. Balances and sequences are never fabricated: an unavailable domain is an explicit -32001 rather than a zero.

methods.name: px_getBalances
methods.description: Per-asset balances on both domains for one account. Assets come from the public core asset registry ordered by asset_id and are joined with the custody precompile's getAsset; the Paxeer amount is the bank precompile's balance(address,denom) and the LayerX amount is the DID's account for that asset. At most the first 16 assets are joined per answer, reported as joined_limit. Amounts are exact decimal strings of the on-chain 256-bit values.

methods.name: px_listAssets
methods.description: The joined asset map: for each LayerX asset (asset_id, denom and its public core record) the custody precompile's record on Paxeer (pointer, enabled, paused, minimum_deposit, custody_cap, custodied, released, pending), or null when the asset is not registered with custody. At most 16 assets are joined per answer, reported as joined_limit. Takes no arguments.

methods.name: px_getNetwork
methods.description: One head for the whole network: network_id, paxeer {chain_id, latest_block} from eth_chainId and eth_blockNumber, layerx {node_info} from the public core node information, and anchor {latest_finalized_batch, status, status_name, status_ladder} from the anchor precompile's latestFinalized and statusOf. The status ladder is the anchor's own: 0 unknown, 1 submitted, 2 final. Takes no arguments.

methods.name: lx_getHistory

params.name: cursor
params.description: The opaque next_cursor of the previous page, passed to the indexer unchanged; null or absent for the newest page.

params.name: kind
params.description: Only rows of this indexer kind, for example lxp_transfer, native_transfer, erc20_transfer or custody_deposit.

id.description: The indexer row id; rows are ordered newest first by it.

height_or_seq.description: The LayerX sequence or Paxeer block height of the row.

chain.description: The chain that recorded the row.

amount.description: Exact decimal amount in the asset's base units.

final.description: True once the row is below its chain's finalized boundary.

decoded.description: The indexer's decoded payload for the row.

asset_metadata.description: The row's asset joined from the indexer's /v1/assets record and the LayerX asset registry, or null when the indexer has no record of the asset.

asset.description: The indexer asset label: 64-hex LayerX asset id, evm:native, evm:<address> or denom:<denom>.

kind.description: The indexer asset kind: layerx, native, erc20, pointer, bank or tokenfactory.

address.description: The EVM contract address for erc20 and pointer assets.

denom.description: The Cosmos denom for bank, tokenfactory and pointer assets.

symbol.description: The indexer metadata symbol, else the LayerX registry symbol of the asset (by asset id) or of its denom; null when neither declares one.

decimals.description: The indexer metadata decimals, else the LayerX registry decimals, else 18 for the EVM native coin; null when nothing declares them.

native_id.description: The LayerX asset id this asset is, or that the registry maps its denom to.

pointer.description: The EVM pointer contract address when the asset is a pointer.

metadata.description: The indexer's own metadata document for the asset.

next_cursor.description: The opaque cursor of the next older page, or null when this page is the last.

methods.description: The indexed transfer history of one LayerX account, newest first, from the layerx-indexer read API. Rows are the indexer's own (including Paxeer custody rows credited to the account), each joined with asset_metadata. Cursors are the indexer's, passed through unchanged. An account the indexer has never seen answers an empty page.

methods.name: px_getUnifiedHistory

params.name: account
params.description: An EVM address, a did:layerx:<hex> DID or a bare 64-hex DID public key, resolved as px_resolveAccount does.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The opaque next_cursor of the previous page, passed to the indexer unchanged; null or absent for the newest page.

params.name: kind
params.description: Only rows of this indexer kind, for example lxp_transfer, native_transfer, erc20_transfer or custody_deposit.

account.description: The px_resolveAccount document of the account.

accounts.description: The indexer account keys merged: the EVM address and every LayerX account of the bound DID (main account and the public core's per-asset accounts), at most 16.

id.description: The indexer row id; rows are ordered newest first by it.

height_or_seq.description: The LayerX sequence or Paxeer block height of the row.

chain.description: The chain that recorded the row.

amount.description: Exact decimal amount in the asset's base units.

metadata.description: The indexer's own metadata document for the asset.

side.description: Which half of the unified account the row belongs to.

next_cursor.description: The opaque cursor of the next older page, or null when this page is the last.

methods.description: One history for the whole unified account: the account is resolved as px_resolveAccount does and the indexer pages of its EVM address and of each of its LayerX accounts are merged newest first in the indexer's row order, each row tagged with side and carrying its chain and asset_metadata. Every side is read at the same cursor, so next_cursor is the indexer row cursor of the last row returned and pages chain without gaps or repeats.
